What makes Cognizant Netcentric a great fit for you? 
 At Cognizant Netcentric, we create memorable digital experiences for the world’s leading brands. We are a diverse, global community of Adobe experts working across countries, cultures, and technologies.
 Our inclusive culture blends the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup with the stability, resources, and learning opportunities of a global organisation.
 With Holacracy at our core, every individual is empowered to make an impact.
 Overview 
 The B2B Contracting Data Analyst works overarchingly across the B2B Contracting cluster , connecting business needs, product development and the wider B2B data landscape and strategy.
 The role will initially focus on supporting the Future Contracting transformation (migration to a new contracting tool), including Conga CLM (Contracting Lifecycle Management), CPQ (Configure Price Quote) and Rebate Management, while establishing a sustainable analytics and measurement setup for Contracting.
 The data analyst works in close collaboration with business and tech stakeholders - VS B2B DA Lead, data architecture & engineering, contracting product managers and product teams, sales and CRM counterparts.
 Key Responsibilities 
Coordinate Data Analytics topics across Contracting , working across product teams and stakeholders.
Define KPIs, measurement concepts and reporting requirements , translating business needs into actionable data requirements and technical work items.
Map existing reports and dependencies across various data sources (sales, CRM, contracting and others) and support their transition into the future Contracting landscape.
Analyze contract performance, value realization, incentives/rebates and other commercial topics to generate actionable insights.
Partner closely with Product Management, Business Analysts, Data Architects and Data Engineers to ensure data requirements are embedded in product development.
Drive consistency in KPI definitions, data quality and reporting across Contracting.
 Requirements 
Strong experience in Data Analytics , ideally in B2B, commercial, sales or contracting environments.
Strong SQL skills and experience with Python/PySpark, Databricks and Tableau or comparable tools.
Experience working with complex, multi-source datasets and translating business questions into analytical solutions.
Strong stakeholder management and ability to bridge business and technical teams .
Proactive, structured and comfortable working across several teams
Experience with CRM, sales, contracting, CLM/CPQ or incentive/rebate data is a strong plus.
Experience or a good understanding of data engineering is a strong plus.
